blocks.text: Are you trouble with your outdoor dining table too small? Here. A patio dining set with an oversized table and six chairs. With a modern style and classic colors, this set will perfectly decorate the patio, the porch, the pool, or the garden. This is definitely the ideal dining set for you.

items: The breathable back and seat make you feel comfortable.
Extra large table allows you to put all kinds of food and drinks.
The chairs are stackable, which saves a lot of storage space and makes it easy to carry.
Steel covered with a special powder coating is used to ensure the stability of the frame.
The special weaving process not only ensures softness, but also provides sufficient weight-bearing capacity.

blocks.text:
Product Specifications:
 Meterial: Textilene, steel
 Color: Light Grey
 Include: 6 chairs, 1 table and instruction
 Dimensions of table: 59.06 inch (L)*35.43 inch (W)*27.95 inch (H)
 Dimensions of chair: 21.85 inch (L)*18.9 inch (W)*34.06 inch

items.label: Warm Tips
items.value: The furniture set will be shipped in two boxes and may arrive on different days. Please be patient for the second boxes, or ask us for specific logistics information. If there are any product or other issues, please let us know and we address the matter

items.label: Large Tabletop
items.value: The large 59*35 inch tabletop allows you to enjoy a variety of food and drinks. The surface of the table is made of faux wood plastic, and the wood grain makes the table more textured. The specially coated table top is weather resistant, making the table more suitable for outdoor use

items.label: Powder-Coated Steel
items.value: This outdoor dining set are made of high-strength steel and double-layer construction to ensure stability and weighing capacity. The steel is wrapped by a special powder coating that features excellent weather and corrosion resistance. Premium materials ensure that this furniture set will last for a long time

items.label: Stackable Chairs
items.value: The patio table and chairs includes six chairs and a table, so you don't have to worry about not having enough chairs. It is ideal for dining with family and gathering with friends. The six chairs are stackable, which saves a lot of storage space and makes it easy to carry

items.label: Breathable Teslin Fabric
items.value: The back and seat are woven from carefully selected Teslin fabrics. Teslin fabric in a tight and orderly arrangement not only has a good elasticity, but also has a strong breathability. This ensures the comfort and softness of the chair while ensuring the load-bearing capacity
